items.description: Harden lock and state-file opens against FIFO/symlink blocking: apply the acquire_at guard (O_NOFOLLOW, nonblocking open, regular-file + single-link check, size cap; see batch 261028-n0u WR-10/WR-08) to src/driver/lock.rs probe_at and read_holder_at (Phase 27 WR-04, Phase 30 WR-11, Phase 31 WR-01) and to the startup opens of DIRECTION.lock in src/driverctl/serve.rs ~934-939 and state.json in src/driverctl/store.rs ~644 (Phase 27 WR-03); close the pending todo about two other lock-file opens lacking these guards if it is the same set; factor a shared helper where natural; add tests that a planted FIFO does not block and a symlink is refused; update dispositions to fixed in phases 27, 30, 31

Keep the human's save when DIRECTION.md is missing at the first exchange-back in src/driver/direction.rs run_loop ~901-914 (Phase 30 WR-12, Phase 31 WR-03, completes WR-10): the save must not be left at a hidden temp file the next sweep deletes nor error, while a crashed run must still never dispatch on a missing DIRECTION.md (see the Phase 28 WR-04 deferral reasoning); add a test; update dispositions to fixed in phases 30, 31

Make host settings merge fail closed in src/launcher/config_dir.rs ~583-616 (Phase 28 WR-08, Phase 29 WR-02): a host hooks or permissions value that is not a JSON object must never replace the launcher's gate hooks or deny list; add tests for string, array, null and number host values; update dispositions to fixed in phases 28, 29
